alternative.src/quote.mjs: import {billable,oversize} from './weight.mjs';export function quote(items,z){const out=[];for(const p of items){if(oversize(p,z.maxSide)){out.push({id:p.id,status:'rejected',reason:'oversize'});continue;}const grams=billable(p,z.divisor),steps=Math.floor((grams+z.stepGrams-1)/z.stepGrams);out.push({id:p.id,status:'quoted',grams,cents:z.base+steps*z.stepCents});}return out;}
